purpose: A subpixel-only selected marker must not count as a visible selection cue merely because its color contrasts.
method: Temporarily reset selected background and border to ordinary control paint and add a contrasting 0.1 CSS-pixel pseudo-element; reduce the shelf marker to the same thickness. Rebuild the native extension from the perturbed source.
